items.description: A flaw in FreeIPA lets a client that has never logged in create a Kerberos identity of its own choosing in the directory and end up in the administrators group, Red Hat says. items.title: BigBear 2.0 Evilginx2 Phishing Campaign Bypasses Microsoft 365 MFA With Session Cookie Theft
items.description: BigBear 2.0 is a phishing operation designed to steal proof that a user has already passed multi-factor authentication. It targets Microsoft 365 accounts through convincing sign-in links, then takes over the logged-in browser session rather than attempting to break the authentication factor. items.title: 220 million traveler records exposed in Vietnam-linked APIS leak
items.description: Exclusive: An exposed Advance Passenger Information System (APIS) database held 220 million passenger and crew records containing names, passport numbers, dates of birth, nationalities, and flight details spanning 2017 to 2026. Researchers accessed the Vietnam-linked system through a cloud-based path using default credentials. [...]

items.title: Grindr to Pay £26 Million to Settle U.K. Claims Over HIV Status Data Sharing
items.description: Online dating app Grindr has opted to pay £26 million ($35.1 million) to settle a lawsuit in the U.K. over allegations that it shared users' personal information, including their HIV status, with third-parties. Grindr, which is the largest LGBTQ+ dating app, was sued in April 2024, accusing it of violating U.K. privacy laws by sharing sensitive data for commercial purposes such as advertising.
